canonical_and_scalar_rules.parse: _parse_canonical(raw): require type(raw) is bytes; UTF-8 strict decode; json.loads(text, parse_constant=_reject_constant, object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_pairs), each always raises for a constant or duplicate key. Recursively admit only dict with str keys, list, str, None, bool, int (bool before int), and finite float; reject all other values. Every declared closed shape rejects null and float.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.serialize: _canonical_json_bytes(value): same recursive JSON domain; json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode('ascii'). Parsed raw must byte-equal this result. Escaped non-ASCII is ASCII \u spelling; keys sort by this serializer; private trust functions are never called.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Obj: JSON object with exactly listed keys; null/default/alias/extra/missing refuses.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Arr[T]: JSON array whose every item is T and obeys its named order/uniqueness rule; no rule is implicit.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.S: JSON string; empty allowed because ADR-0125 supplies no tighter local rule.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.I: JSON integer where type(value) is int; bool, float and coercion refuse.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.signature: S passed unchanged to ReleaseKeyring.verify; no invented codec/base64 rule.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.local_self: Unsigned object SHA-256(canonical object with exactly named self removed) equals self. Signed envelope removes exactly named self and signature; SHA-256(preimage)=self and identical preimage is keyring message.

sort_and_uniqueness.byte_comparator: B compares bytes unsigned-octet left-to-right; first lower wins, a complete prefix is shorter, equality ties; never decoded-Unicode/locale/code-point/platform order.
sort_and_uniqueness.field_key: K(x)=canonical bytes(x); K(tuple)=canonical bytes([x1,...,xn]) in exact stated order. Ascend by B(K). strict means adjacent B(K)<0 and stated key unique. complete means B of complete canonical item and strict rejects duplicate complete bytes.

arrays.ScopeIntent.replay_intents and ReplayInt: strict replay_id; exactly control and crash-restart
arrays.CAS.entries: ascending (planned_entry_sha256 by B(K), then complete PCE bytes by B); equal full bytes refuse
arrays.converted CES PCEs: sort by exact CAS pair before item-for-item comparison
arrays.all other arrays: no other array in supplied closed schema; adding one refuses

sort_and_uniqueness.non_ascii_case: Every sort RED includes z and U+00E9 (serialized \u00e9) and accepts only B/K order.

suffix.composition: Every envelope exact keys = its table plus this suffix, named_self replaced by its named self; suffix cannot repeat and no other key admitted.

signed_envelope_rules.common: not_before_ms <= issued_at_ms <= expires_at_ms. Call clock.now_ms exactly once; require type result is int and apply that one instant inclusively to every envelope. keyring.verify(key.key_id,key.key_version,issued_at_ms,preimage,signature) is True and revocations.is_unrevoked(snapshot,key.key_id,key.key_version,now_ms) is True; false, non-bool, exception, unknown, unavailable, lazy lookup or stale snapshot refuses.

profile_and_local_link_rules.select_scope_child_first: After child self/set validity but before child field comparisons, require complete canonical CES/PEA/BVP/CAS subject bytes equal. ActionSubject selects exactly one Scope.action_intents member by action_id+self; ReplaySubject exactly one Scope.replay_intents by replay_id+self. Zero/multiple refuses; only selected child is used.

profiles.replay_pre_final: phase PIS replay-consumer; CES/PEA replay-pre-final ReplaySubject; AuthorityRef scope-authorization-replay intent=subject; selected FinalReplayAdmission; root/phase PIS un-compared.

profile_and_local_link_rules.projection: Each CES nested PIS item byte-equals exactly one phase PIS entry by input_id. Convert CES entries to PCEs by literal schema/common subject/computed self; CAS-sort and item/cardinality compare to CAS. P(CES)==P(CAS), never P(BVP).
profile_and_local_link_rules.root_membership: Roots have empty predecessor arrays; each root ID selects one root PIS input_id. Nonroots root IDs empty. PIS strict ordering independently rejects duplicate entries.
